description: Source code implementing API endpoints for a FastAPI web application, including session management, dataset status checks, and CSV upload handling for an energy data demo app.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Data model representing session details such as session ID and timestamps.

classes.name: DatasetStatusResponse
classes.description: Data model representing dataset payload status including session info, payload presence, keys, and preview.

classes.name: CsvUploadPreviewResponse
classes.description: Data model representing the response to CSV upload, including session info, filename, preview rows, schema, and warnings.

methods.name: str _ensure_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Ensures a session exists, creating one if necessary, and sets the session cookie.

methods.name: SessionInfo get_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None))
methods.description: Returns current session information, creating a session if it does not exist.

methods.name: DatasetStatusResponse get_dataset_status(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None))
methods.description: Provides status of dataset payload for the current session with a small preview.

methods.name: CsvUploadPreviewResponse upload_dataset_csv( response: Response, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="CSV file containing electricity/energy usage data."), vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), )
methods.description: Handles CSV file upload, parses, cleans, and stores preview data in session for further processing.

ctags.name: get_session
ctags.pattern: /^def get_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None)) -> Sess/

ctags.name: upload_dataset_csv
ctags.signature: ( response: Response, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="CSV file containing electricity/energy usage data."), vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), )
